R1.description: docs/backlog.yaml holds one validated item per Controller-lane and orchestrator-series roadmap row, with unique orders, done items marked, A2a in progress and A2b the next ready item; a test pins it

R2.description: The backlog is declared in WORKFLOW_CONFIG.json, the old roadmap moves unchanged to docs/roadmap-archive.md, docs/ROADMAP.md is the generated page, and inbound links point to the archive

R3.description: A test fails when the generated page is stale, so the existing CI test jobs carry the check

R4.description: The development guide, the documentation map and the sizing paragraph describe the backlog and the generated roadmap
